qualification.details: M.P.Ed. degree or its equivalent with at least 55% marks or its equivalent grade, i.e., B in the seven-point scale of letter grades O, A, B, C, D, E, F as per UGC norms. A minimum of eight years of experience of teaching and/or research in an academic/research position equivalent to that of Assistant Professor in a University, College or Accredited Research Institution/industry, excluding the period of Ph.D. research. Note: Any other stipulation prescribed by UGC/Affiliating Body/State Govt. from time to time for the position of Associate Professor shall be mandatory. | Masters in nutrition, or Bachelor degree in home science with diploma in nutrition and dietetics. | Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility of each post.

salary_details.pay_scale: ₹2,000/- per day (max ₹50,000/- per month); ₹500/- per day (max ₹15,000/- per month)

how_to_apply: Applications are sent by email only, and selection is through an online walk-in interview. The advertisement attaches an "Application Form for ... (Direct Recruitment)" (pages 2 to 6 of the PDF).
Fill in the Direct Recruitment application form attached to the advertisement, writing the advertisement number and date, the post applied for, field of specialisation and department.

Complete the details asked in the form: personal details, academic qualifications, NET/SLET/GATE particulars, past services, publications, conferences, research projects, awards, research scholars guided, present position and pay, and two referees not related to you.
Sign the declaration and the list of enclosures.
Email the application with all relevant supporting documents to [email protected] on or before 16 November 2026.
Watch your registered email address: the Google Meet link will be communicated to eligible candidates there.
Attend the online walk-in interview through Google Meet on 17 November 2026 from 11:00 am onwards.
The application form also asks for details of the fee paid by Demand Draft (amount, date, bank and branch), but the advertisement does not state the fee amount.
important_instructions: Incomplete applications, applications without the application fees or without the signature are likely to be rejected. For Associate Professor, any other stipulation prescribed by UGC/Affiliating Body/State Govt. from time to time shall be mandatory. In the publications section, give totals for the entire career and for the last 5 years. For research scholars guided, list only PhDs awarded; those "under progress" are not to be included. The declaration states that the competent authority can take action if any information is found to be incorrect at any stage.

Supporting documents for past services. Lists of other publications, conferences and seminars (optional, may be attached). A signed list of enclosures (certificates and other necessary documents).

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in Bhattadev University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies: one Associate Professor and one Dietician in the Department of Physical Education and Sports.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Applications must be emailed on or before 16 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for Associate Professor?
faq.answer: An M.P.Ed. degree or equivalent with at least 55% marks (grade B on the UGC seven-point scale), at least eight years of teaching and/or research experience equivalent to Assistant Professor excluding Ph.D. research, and a minimum of 5 publications.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for Dietician?
faq.answer: Masters in nutrition, or a Bachelor degree in home science with a diploma in nutrition and dietetics.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary?
faq.answer: Associate Professor gets ₹2,000 per day subject to a maximum of ₹50,000 per month; Dietician gets ₹500 per day subject to a maximum of ₹15,000 per month.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Send the filled application form with all relevant supporting documents by email to [email protected] on or before 16 November 2026.

faq.question: Q7. When and how is the interview held?
faq.answer: The online walk-in interview will be held through Google Meet on 17 November 2026 from 11:00 am onwards; the meeting link will be sent to eligible candidates at their registered email addresses.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The appointments are purely temporary for one (1) year and may be extended, subject to the University's requirements and approval of the competent authority.
